  "source": "namespace Contribution\n\nopen B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution\n\nvariable {G : Type} [Group G] {d L : ℕ}\n\n/-- Ordered product `U_{b,τ} U_{b+τ,τ} ⋯ U_{b+(k-1)τ,τ}` of the first `k` links on the\n`τ`-line starting at `b`. -/\ndef linePath (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : ℕ → G\n  | 0 => 1\n  | k + 1 => linePath U b τ k * U (b + k • e τ) τ\n\n/-- The Polyakov loop: the holonomy once around the periodic `τ`-direction from `b`. -/\ndef polyakovLoop (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : G :=\n  linePath U b τ L\n\n/-- The point of the `τ = 0` slice on the `τ`-line through `x`. -/\ndef sliceBase (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : Site d L :=\n  Function.update x τ 0\n\n/-- The axial-gauge transformation: transport along the `τ`-line from the base slice. -/\ndef axialGauge (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) : GaugeTransform G d L :=\n  fun x => linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ (x τ).val\n\ntheorem linePath_zero (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :\n    linePath U b τ 0 = 1 := rfl\n\ntheorem linePath_succ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :\n    linePath U b τ (k + 1) = linePath U b τ k * U (b + k • e τ) τ := rfl\n\ntheorem e_self (τ : Fin d) : (e τ : Site d L) τ = 1 := by\n  show (Pi.single τ (1 : ZMod L) : Fin d → ZMod L) τ = 1\n  exact Pi.single_eq_same _ _\n\ntheorem e_ne {τ μ : Fin d} (h : μ ≠ τ) : (e τ : Site d L) μ = 0 := by\n  show (Pi.single τ (1 : ZMod L) : Fin d → ZMod L) μ = 0\n  exact Pi.single_eq_of_ne h _\n\ntheorem sliceBase_add_e (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :\n    sliceBase (x + e τ) τ = sliceBase x τ := by\n  funext μ\n  by_cases h : μ = τ\n  · subst h; simp [sliceBase]\n  · simp only [sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne h, Pi.add_apply, e_ne h, add_zero]\n\ntheorem sliceBase_add_val [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :\n    sliceBase x τ + (x τ).val • e τ = x := by\n  funext μ\n  by_cases h : μ = τ\n  · subst h\n    rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, e_self]\n    simp only [sliceBase, Function.update_self, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add,\n      ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]\n  · simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne h, e_ne h,\n      smul_zero, add_zero]\n\ntheorem add_e_apply (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : (x + e τ : Site d L) τ = x τ + 1 := by\n  simp only [Pi.add_apply, e_self]\n\ntheorem val_add_e_of_lt [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hx : (x τ).val + 1 < L) :\n    ((x + e τ : Site d L) τ).val = (x τ).val + 1 := by\n  rw [add_e_apply, ZMod.val_add, ZMod.val_one_eq_one_mod, Nat.one_mod_eq_one.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left 1 _) hx)),\n    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]\n\ntheorem val_add_e_of_last [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hx : (x τ).val + 1 = L) :\n    ((x + e τ : Site d L) τ).val = 0 := by\n  have h1 : (x + e τ : Site d L) τ = (((x τ).val + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod L) := by\n    rw [add_e_apply]; push_cast; rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]\n  rw [h1, hx, ZMod.natCast_self, ZMod.val_zero]\n\n/-- Away from the last slice, the axial gauge trivializes every `τ`-link. -/\ntheorem axialGauge_link [NeZero L] (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) (x : Site d L)\n    (hx : (x τ).val + 1 < L) : gaugeAct (axialGauge U τ) U x τ = 1 := by\n  simp only [gaugeAct, axialGauge]\n  rw [sliceBase_add_e, val_add_e_of_lt x τ hx, linePath_succ, sliceBase_add_val]\n  exact mul_inv_cancel _\n\n/-- On the last slice, the remaining `τ`-link is the Polyakov loop through `x`. -/\ntheorem axialGauge_last [NeZero L] (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) (x : Site d L)\n    (hx : (x τ).val + 1 = L) :\n    gaugeAct (axialGauge U τ) U x τ = polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ := by\n  simp only [gaugeAct, axialGauge]\n  rw [sliceBase_add_e, val_add_e_of_last x τ hx, linePath_zero, inv_one, mul_one,\n    polyakovLoop, show linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ L =\n      linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ ((x τ).val + 1) from congrArg _ hx.symm,\n    linePath_succ, sliceBase_add_val]\n\n/-- Axial (temporal) gauge on the periodic lattice `(ℤ/Lℤ)^d`, for any gauge group and any\ndirection `τ`: every configuration is gauge equivalent to one whose `τ`-links are trivial off\nthe last slice and equal the Polyakov loops on it; every class-function plaquette action\n(in particular the Wilson action) is unchanged. -/\ntheorem result :\n    ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (τ : Fin d) (U : LinkConfig G d L),\n      ∃ g : GaugeTransform G d L,\n        (∀ x : Site d L, (x τ).val + 1 < L → gaugeAct g U x τ = 1) ∧\n        (∀ x : Site d L, (x τ).val + 1 = L →\n          gaugeAct g U x τ = polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ) ∧\n        (∀ f : G → ℝ, IsClassFunction f → latticeAction f (gaugeAct g U) = latticeAction f U) := by\n  intro G _ d L _ τ U\n  refine ⟨axialGauge U τ, fun x hx => axialGauge_link U τ x hx,\n    fun x hx => axialGauge_last U τ x hx, fun f hf => ?_⟩\n  exact (B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution.result).1\n    G d L f hf (axialGauge U τ) U\n\nend Contribution\n",

submission.title: Axial gauge on the periodic lattice: every gauge field reduces to Polyakov loops on one slice
submission.claim: For any group G, any d, L ≥ 1, any direction τ and any link configuration U on the periodic lattice (ℤ/Lℤ)^d, the Lean theorem Contribution.result constructs an explicit gauge transformation g (parallel transport along the τ-line from the slice x_τ = 0) such that: (1) every τ-link off the last slice becomes trivial, (gU)_{x,τ} = 1 whenever x_τ + 1 < L; (2) on the last slice, x_τ = L − 1, the remaining τ-link equals the Polyakov loop P(b) = U_{b,τ} U_{b+τ,τ} ⋯ U_{b+(L−1)τ,τ} of the τ-line through x, with b its point on the slice x_τ = 0; (3) every class-function plaquette action, including the Wilson action of accepted contribution pr-10, is unchanged. This is the axial (temporal) gauge used to build the transfer matrix and Hamiltonian formulation and in Faddeev–Popov arguments on finite lattices. On the torus the τ-links cannot all be removed. The statement pins down the exact obstruction: one Polyakov loop per τ-line. It is the gauge-invariant data that center symmetry acts on.
submission.novelty: This builds on the accepted track result pr-10 (lattice, plaquettes, gauge action, class-function action invariance), which it imports and uses. The mathematics is classical (axial/temporal gauge, e.g. Creutz's and Montvay–Münster's textbooks). In the external Lean library lgt (Douglas), the corresponding step is not proved. lgt's GaugeFixing.lean states that constructing the gauge transform that fixes the axial links 'requires' the tree argument, and its faddeevPopov theorem takes the Faddeev–Popov identity as a hypothesis, hFP. This bundle supplies an explicit, axiom-clean construction for the periodic lattice, any group and any direction, together with the exact Polyakov-loop residue on the last slice.

submission.limitations: This is a purely classical, configuration-level statement. It does not prove the Faddeev–Popov identity for the Haar/Wilson measure (Fubini and Haar invariance are not formalized), and it does not construct the transfer matrix. Only τ-links are fixed. Gauge fixing of spatial links (a full maximal-tree gauge) and the residual τ-independent gauge freedom are not treated. Uniqueness of the gauge-fixed form is not proved. Nothing here addresses the quantum theory, the continuum limit or the mass gap.

{
  "version": 2,
  "imports": [
    "Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic",
    "Mathlib.Tactic.Group"
  ],
  "source": "namespace Contribution

open B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution

variable {G : Type} [Group G] {d L : ℕ}

/-- Ordered product `U_{b,τ} U_{b+τ,τ} ⋯ U_{b+(k-1)τ,τ}` of the first `k` links on the
`τ`-line starting at `b`. -/
def linePath (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : ℕ → G
  | 0 => 1
  | k + 1 => linePath U b τ k * U (b + k • e τ) τ

/-- The Polyakov loop: the holonomy once around the periodic `τ`-direction from `b`. -/
def polyakovLoop (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : G :=
  linePath U b τ L

/-- The point of the `τ = 0` slice on the `τ`-line through `x`. -/
def sliceBase (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : Site d L :=
  Function.update x τ 0

/-- The axial-gauge transformation: transport along the `τ`-line from the base slice. -/
def axialGauge (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) : GaugeTransform G d L :=
  fun x => linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ (x τ).val

theorem linePath_zero (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :
    linePath U b τ 0 = 1 := rfl

theorem linePath_succ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :
    linePath U b τ (k + 1) = linePath U b τ k * U (b + k • e τ) τ := rfl

theorem e_self (τ : Fin d) : (e τ : Site d L) τ = 1 := by
  show (Pi.single τ (1 : ZMod L) : Fin d → ZMod L) τ = 1
  exact Pi.single_eq_same _ _

theorem e_ne {τ μ : Fin d} (h : μ ≠ τ) : (e τ : Site d L) μ = 0 := by
  show (Pi.single τ (1 : ZMod L) : Fin d → ZMod L) μ = 0
  exact Pi.single_eq_of_ne h _

theorem sliceBase_add_e (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :
    sliceBase (x + e τ) τ = sliceBase x τ := by
  funext μ
  by_cases h : μ = τ
  · subst h; simp [sliceBase]
  · simp only [sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne h, Pi.add_apply, e_ne h, add_zero]

theorem sliceBase_add_val [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :
    sliceBase x τ + (x τ).val • e τ = x := by
  funext μ
  by_cases h : μ = τ
  · subst h
    rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, e_self]
    simp only [sliceBase, Function.update_self, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add,
      ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  · simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne h, e_ne h,
      smul_zero, add_zero]

theorem add_e_apply (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : (x + e τ : Site d L) τ = x τ + 1 := by
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, e_self]

theorem val_add_e_of_lt [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hx : (x τ).val + 1 < L) :
    ((x + e τ : Site d L) τ).val = (x τ).val + 1 := by
  rw [add_e_apply, ZMod.val_add, ZMod.val_one_eq_one_mod, Nat.one_mod_eq_one.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left 1 _) hx)),
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]

theorem val_add_e_of_last [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hx : (x τ).val + 1 = L) :
    ((x + e τ : Site d L) τ).val = 0 := by
  have h1 : (x + e τ : Site d L) τ = (((x τ).val + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod L) := by
    rw [add_e_apply]; push_cast; rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  rw [h1, hx, ZMod.natCast_self, ZMod.val_zero]

/-- Away from the last slice, the axial gauge trivializes every `τ`-link. -/
theorem axialGauge_link [NeZero L] (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) (x : Site d L)
    (hx : (x τ).val + 1 < L) : gaugeAct (axialGauge U τ) U x τ = 1 := by
  simp only [gaugeAct, axialGauge]
  rw [sliceBase_add_e, val_add_e_of_lt x τ hx, linePath_succ, sliceBase_add_val]
  exact mul_inv_cancel _

/-- On the last slice, the remaining `τ`-link is the Polyakov loop through `x`. -/
theorem axialGauge_last [NeZero L] (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) (x : Site d L)
    (hx : (x τ).val + 1 = L) :
    gaugeAct (axialGauge U τ) U x τ = polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ := by
  simp only [gaugeAct, axialGauge]
  rw [sliceBase_add_e, val_add_e_of_last x τ hx, linePath_zero, inv_one, mul_one,
    polyakovLoop, show linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ L =
      linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ ((x τ).val + 1) from congrArg _ hx.symm,
    linePath_succ, sliceBase_add_val]

/-- Axial (temporal) gauge on the periodic lattice `(ℤ/Lℤ)^d`, for any gauge group and any
direction `τ`: every configuration is gauge equivalent to one whose `τ`-links are trivial off
the last slice and equal the Polyakov loops on it; every class-function plaquette action
(in particular the Wilson action) is unchanged. -/
theorem result :
    ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (τ : Fin d) (U : LinkConfig G d L),
      ∃ g : GaugeTransform G d L,
        (∀ x : Site d L, (x τ).val + 1 < L → gaugeAct g U x τ = 1) ∧
        (∀ x : Site d L, (x τ).val + 1 = L →
          gaugeAct g U x τ = polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ) ∧
        (∀ f : G → ℝ, IsClassFunction f → latticeAction f (gaugeAct g U) = latticeAction f U) := by
  intro G _ d L _ τ U
  refine ⟨axialGauge U τ, fun x hx => axialGauge_link U τ x hx,
    fun x hx => axialGauge_last U τ x hx, fun f hf => ?_⟩
  exact (B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution.result).1
    G d L f hf (axialGauge U τ) U

end Contribution
